commit.message:
Reduce transient allocations on map-io  (#6437)

* Reduce transient allocations

Signed-off-by: Sebastian Solarte <johan.solarte@kiwibot.com>

* Classify map pixels via a 256-entry LUT

The previous approach rewrote the occupancy thresholds algebraically to
compare against raw grayscale values. That is equivalent in real arithmetic
but not in float: (1 - g/255) >= thresh and g <= (1 - thresh) * 255 round
differently, so boundary pixels changed class. Scale mode was worse still,
since in_between_mask was computed from a separate float matrix, so a cell
could be classified occupied and then overwritten by an in-between value.

A grayscale pixel has only 256 possible values, so classify each one up
front and index the table per pixel. This keeps the original float
arithmetic verbatim, so classification is bit-for-bit unchanged, and it
drops every width*height intermediate including scale mode's, which the
previous version still allocated.

Verified identical output against the original for all 256 gray levels
across 6.3M threshold/negate/mode combinations.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Reduce Nav2 build dependencies with narrower includes and target exports (#6558)

* Narrow rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp includes in nav2_behavior_tree and nav2_mppi_controller

Replace the umbrella rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp include with the specific
rclcpp headers each translation unit actually needs (logging, time,
duration, callback_group, etc.), scoped to nav2_behavior_tree and
nav2_mppi_controller as a validated pilot of the approach.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* nav2_mppi_controller: link Eigen3 per-target instead of global include_directories

Remove the blanket include_directories(include, EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR)
and link Eigen3::Eigen explicitly on each target that needs it, so
Eigen headers aren't force-included into every translation unit in
the package regardless of whether it uses Eigen.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* Narrow rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp includes in nav2_ros_common

nav2_ros_common's node_utils.hpp, lifecycle_node.hpp, and related
headers are included by nearly every file in nav2_behavior_tree and
nav2_mppi_controller, so their own umbrella rclcpp.hpp include was
re-pulling in everything the previous commit trimmed. Narrow these
too so the include reduction actually reaches the target packages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* Narrow rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp includes across the rest of the stack

Extend the rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp -> targeted-header narrowing (already
applied to nav2_behavior_tree, nav2_mppi_controller, and
nav2_ros_common) to the remaining ~29 packages that used the
umbrella include, plus the transitive-dependency header fixes
(e.g. nav2_util/lifecycle_service_client.hpp needing rclcpp/rate.hpp
explicitly once it could no longer rely on rclcpp.hpp being pulled
in transitively via nav2_ros_common) discovered while validating the
narrower nav2_ros_common headers against the rest of the workspace.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* nav2_ros_common: restore tf2/tf2_ros/tf2_geometry_msgs package.xml deps

These were dropped from package.xml by the rclcpp.hpp narrowing work,
but nav2_ros_common/include/nav2_ros_common/tf2_factories.hpp directly
includes tf2_ros/buffer.hpp, create_timer_ros.hpp, transform_listener.hpp,
etc. and defines the nav2::TransformBuffer alias used throughout nav2_core.
CMakeLists.txt still correctly finds/links/exports these; only the
package.xml declarations were (incorrectly) removed. This only didn't
break local builds because tf2_ros/tf2/tf2_geometry_msgs happen to
already be resolvable in the build environment regardless.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* Remove unused direct dependencies found while auditing the narrowing

- nav2_behavior_tree: rclcpp_lifecycle (only referenced in a comment;
  transitively available via nav2_ros_common anyway)
- nav2_mppi_controller: tf2_ros (transitively available via
  nav2_costmap_2d and nav2_ros_common)
- nav2_lifecycle_manager, nav2_navfn_planner, nav2_util: leftover
  rclcpp_action/pluginlib/builtin_interfaces link lines with no
  corresponding source usage, already dropped from package.xml by
  earlier work but never cleaned up in CMakeLists.txt
- nav2_system_tests: unused angles::angles link in the wait behavior
  test

Each removal was verified against actual source usage (checking for
type aliases like nav2::LifecycleNode that can hide a real need
behind a name that doesn't literally match, as found with nav2_core)
and confirmed via a full workspace rebuild.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* Remove ament_mypy test dependency

Nav2 has decided to stop using ament_mypy for Python type checking.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* Add semgrep rule to prevent rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp from being reintroduced

Extends the existing nav2::-wrapper enforcement rules with a check
for the umbrella rclcpp.hpp include, which this branch spent effort
removing repo-wide for compile time/memory reasons.

Verified: fires on both `#include "rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp"` and
`#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>`, ignores commented-out lines, and
produces zero findings against the current repo (matching the exact
`semgrep scan --config .semgrep.yml --text --max-lines-per-finding 1
--error` invocation used in .github/workflows/lint.yml).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

* Remove deprecated ament_export_libraries/include_directories calls

These are superseded by target-based exports (target_include_directories
with INSTALL_INTERFACE plus ament_export_targets), so the separate
legacy macros are redundant across all packages. Also merges the
duplicate ament_export_dependencies(Eigen3) call in nav2_costmap_2d
into the main dependency list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: mini-1235 <mauricepurnawan@gmail.com>

commit.message:
Fix RangeSensorLayer update loop for cones off the grid (#6622)

When the cone lies wholly left of or below the grid, the clamped upper
bound stays negative and the unsigned loops run up to ~4e9 iterations
(forever at -1) while the costmap is locked. Iterate with signed indices
and clamp the upper bounds to the last cell.

Signed-off-by: Artem Belousov <gartod@gmail.com>
